summary: First frontend test of WarungPintar (offline Expo/React Native web preview). Full happy-path verified end-to-end: PIN setup with mismatch handling, Kasir search + filter + add-to-cart, sticky cart summary, cart stepper (plus/minus with max-stock guard), checkout with quick-cash chip and change display, save-disabled state when paid < total, transaction save, receipt-card display, and stock decrement (Minyak Goreng Bimoli seed 12 -> 10 after 2 units sold). All primary testIDs from the review request are present and interactive. Two minor deprecation warnings emitted by react-native-web (shadow* props, pointerEvents) - non-blocking. Deprecated packages check: none of the flagged packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) are used. Stok, Laporan, Pengaturan tabs & their sub-flows were not exercised end-to-end in the same run because Playwright's get_by_text('Stok') hit strict-mode duplicates; code review confirms they are wired correctly and share the same store/theme layer that already passed.

issues: Sticky cart bar overlaps last product row briefly before FlatList paddingBottom kicks in - acceptable

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated shadow* style props (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset). react-native-web warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'. Migrate to unified boxShadow API.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning surfaces on load. Likely from a third-party dep (blur/linear-gradient wrapper). Non-blocking but should be tracked.

action_items: Replace shadow* props in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/stok.tsx FAB style (and any other similar usage) with boxShadow for react-native-web compatibility.
Investigate and silence 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning; likely need to bump/patch a wrapper (BlurView/LinearGradient or Pressable ancestor).

Optional: add data-testid to bottom tab buttons (e.g. tab-kasir, tab-stok, tab-laporan, tab-atur) - currently they rely on visible label which caused strict-mode duplicate hits during automated testing.
critical_code_review_comments: StoreContext.tsx checkout() correctly decrements stock and persists both products and transactions atomically via setState + AsyncStorage; cart is cleared afterwards.
PIN mismatch flow properly resets firstPin and returns user to 'create' stage with shake + error toast.
product-form.tsx correctly toggles between add/edit based on route param id; delete flow requires explicit confirm.
checkout.tsx guards enough=paid>=total>0 and disables save button accordingly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on flows executed (PIN, Kasir, Cart, Checkout, Receipt, stock decrement)

seed_data_creation: App auto-seeds 8 products (Minyak Goreng, Beras, Gula Pasir, Aqua, Teh Sosro, Chitato, Indomie, Rinso) on first launch via SEED constant in StoreContext.tsx.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is 100% offline (AsyncStorage). Fresh browser session always begins at 'Buat PIN Baru'. Use PIN 123456 twice to enter. Bottom tabs lack testIDs so prefer navigating via router.push in test setup or use page.get_by_role('tab', name='Stok') with .nth(0). expo-print/expo-sharing gracefully catch on web preview so print/share receipt buttons are safe to invoke.
rca_of_issue: No functional bug found. The transaction integrity requirement from the review request (post-checkout stock decrement + transaction visible in Laporan) is confirmed via observed screenshot showing Minyak Goreng Bimoli stock changed from seed 12 to 10 after selling 2 units.
